name: aegis-stops
description: AEGIS STOPS — reconcile the working stop orders at Tiger against the committee's stop levels for Aegis cash equities. Proposes raises only (ratchet), flags unprotected, breached and unreconcilable names, then on the PM's explicit per-symbol approval writes amend requests for the staging-gatekeeper or a manual Tiger checklist, and verifies the result. Read and compute only: never cancels, places or amends an order.
